Definition: a mountain ridge (as of tied summits)
BiblicalUsage: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low, and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain, for the coming of the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that God levels the rough ground Himself, because no man can walk to Him over it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
